# Big N Lizard

> Big N Lizard is a small, independent tabletop board game studio. We design games with hand-drawn art, warm storytelling, and just enough chaos to make game night memorable. No investors, no committees.

Big N Lizard is a single-page site (https://bignlizard.com/) covering upcoming games, company news/events, and how to get in touch. Content sections are anchors on the homepage.

## Games

- [Pantheon Lorekeepers](https://bignlizard.com/#games): A deck-building card game where players assemble pantheons of gods and battle for supremacy, with strategic combat inspired by Magic: The Gathering. 2–4 players, 15–30 min. Status: Playtesting. Playable demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/toofastturnip/pantheon
- [Elephants Dancing](https://bignlizard.com/#games): A chaotic party game where players attend concerts at a music festival to achieve enlightenment. 2–6 players, 20–60 min. Status: In development.
- [Pantheon Mobile](https://bignlizard.com/#games): A mobile adaptation of Pantheon Lorekeepers. 2–4 players, 15–30 min. Status: Coming 2028.

## News & Events

- [Company News & Events](https://bignlizard.com/#news): Announcements including the Pantheon Lorekeepers demo launch, playtesting sessions at conventions (e.g. No Land Beyond), and an open call for contributing artists.

## About

- [About Big N Lizard](https://bignlizard.com/#about): Studio background and mission.
